title: Shoulder Workout Routine: Build Strength and Definition
transcript: Here is the most effective shoulder workout, the FST-7 shoulder workout by Chris Bumstead coach Haney Rambod. They begin the workout with a few warm-up sets of shoulder presses, very lightweight, just to activate and pump blood in the shoulders. Then they begin the workout with machine lateral raises, doing 7 sets of 8-12 reps. You can even switch this exercise with regular lateral raises. This exercise is legendary and a favorite of gym-goers, I guess. Next, they do the dumbbell shoulder press, doing 4 sets of 8-10 reps. In this ultimate shoulder compound movement, try to lift as much as you can, but maintain proper form so you'll not get injured. After that, do single arm cable lateral raises, doing 2 sets of 8-10 reps each. Lift heavy and maintain slow momentum throughout the movement for better pump. Then do cable front raises, doing 3 sets of 8-10 reps. You won't be able to lift heavy now, so make sure to do it with a complete range of motion. And then they finish their workout with a reverse pec deck fly, doing 3 sets of 8-10 reps. This one will perfectly target your rear delts. Save and share this workout with your gym bro.
summary:
Workout Routine:

1. Warm-up: Shoulder presses with very light weight to activate and pump blood in the shoulders.

2. Exercise 1: Machine lateral raises (can be replaced with regular lateral raises). 7 sets of 8-12 reps.

3. Exercise 2: Dumbbell shoulder press. 4 sets of 8-10 reps. Lift heavy but maintain proper form.

4. Exercise 3: Single arm cable lateral raises. 2 sets of 8-10 reps each. Lift heavy and maintain slow momentum.

5. Exercise 4: Cable front raises. 3 sets of 8-10 reps. 

6. Exercise 5: Reverse pec deck fly. 3 sets of 8-10 reps. 

(Note: Rest periods are not specified in the video transcript.)

title: Complete Leg Workout: Hamstrings, Quads, Glutes
transcript: All right, this is my leg workout based on science and experience. Up first, the seated leg curl for the hamstrings. This gets my knees nice and warm for squats, and I usually pick seated overlying leg curls because this study showed they cause about 1.5 times more muscle growth. Next, I do Smith machine squats for the quads and glutes. Here I get as deep as I can and explode out of the hole. Doing these on the Smith allows me to push my last set to failure without worrying about dumping the bar. After that, it's the Romanian deadlift for the glutes and hamstrings. Here I focus on pushing my hips back without allowing my lower back to round. Using straps on these is smart. Your glutes and hams should be stronger than your grip. Then I do leg extensions for the quads. Here I set the seat back to get a deep stretch in the rectus femoris. On my last set, I do mile reps beyond failure. Basically rest for a few seconds, crank another three reps and repeat. Then I superset two sets of hip abductions for the inner thighs with two sets of hip abductions for the glutes and then four sets of standing calf raises.
summary:
1. Seated leg curl for the hamstrings: No specific sets, reps, or rest periods mentioned. 
2. Smith machine squats for the quads and glutes: No specific sets or reps mentioned but the last set is pushed to failure. 
3. Romanian deadlift for the glutes and hamstrings: Advised to use straps, but no specific sets, reps, or rest periods mentioned. 
4. Leg extensions for the quads: The last set is done with mini reps beyond failure, rest for a few seconds, perform another three reps and repeat. The number of previous sets is not specified.
5. Superset of hip abductions for the inner thighs (two sets) with hip abductions for the glutes (two sets). 
6. Finish with four sets of standing calf raises. No specific reps or rest periods mentioned.
